errors.text_span: Тя използва линейна скала, като началото на осите е на -1%, а краят на осите е на 4%.
errors.evidence: This sentence, which is part of the X-axis description, incorrectly describes the range of the Y-axis. The X-axis represents years (2012-2019), not percentages.

errors.text_span: Линията започва при стойност от -0,5% в 2012 г.
errors.evidence: The description states the line starts at -0.5% in 2012, but the chart clearly shows the starting value is approximately 3.2%.

errors.text_span: и достига максимума си при стойност от 3,5% през 2017 г.
errors.evidence: The description states the maximum value is 3.5% in 2017, but the line on the chart peaks visibly above the 3.50% gridline, at approximately 3.7%.
The description claims the line ends at a value of 2.5% in 2019, but the chart shows the value is closer to 2.2%. The value of 2.5% corresponds to the year 2018.

The description fails to mention the most significant trough (minimum value) of the line, which occurs in 2015 at a negative value of approximately -0.7%. The prompt specifically asks for clearly visible peaks and troughs to be noted.
The phrasing 'през сив цвят' is awkward in Bulgarian. A more natural and grammatically correct phrasing would be 'в сив цвят' (in gray color).
